nodes.description: address public owner; privileged address set in constructor and by transferOwnership
address[] public players; unbounded array appended in enterDraw via players.push
uint256 ticketPrice; price per ticket used in cost computation, owner-settable
uint256 drawId; incremented nine times per pickWinner call, key of pastDraw
uint256 maxTicketsPerTx; cap on tickets per transaction, owner-settable
bool drawLive; entry gate toggled by startEntries/stopEntries
mapping(uint=>address) pastDraw; winner record written in pickWinner and read by getWinnerByDraw
mapping(address=>uint256) userEntries; per-player entry counter written after the external burn call
address public oilAddress; token address configured by setOil
iOIL public Oil; external token interface used for balanceOf and burn calls
constructor(): sets owner=msg.sender and drawId=1
setOil(address) onlyOwner: sets oilAddress and the Oil interface pointer
modifier onlyOwner: require(msg.sender == owner), the sole access-control check in the contract
enterDraw(uint256) payable: entry point; validates balance/drawLive/caps, calls Oil.burn then mutates players and userEntries
getRandom() view: derives pseudo-random index from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and block.coinbase
getPlayers() view: returns the players array
drawEntrys() view: returns players.length
getWinnerByDraw(uint) view: reads pastDraw[_drawId]
playerEntries(address) view: O(n) scan counting occurrences of a player in the players array
pickWinner(...) onlyOwner: derives nine winners from getRandom plus nine owner-supplied salts and writes pastDraw
setTicketPrice(uint256) onlyOwner: updates ticketPrice
setMaxTicket(uint256) onlyOwner: updates maxTicketsPerTx
startEntries() onlyOwner: sets drawLive = true
stopEntries() onlyOwner: sets drawLive = false
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: reassigns the owner state variable
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, entry accounting and token operations
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used as entropy source in getRandom
external call Oil.burn(msg.sender, totalTicketCost) executed before players/userEntries state updates
external view call Oil.balanceOf(msg.sender) used as an entry precondition
arithmetic ticketPrice * _numOfTickets cost computation guarded only by checked math
_numOfTickets parameter of enterDraw: number of tickets the caller wants to buy
totalTicketCost local in enterDraw: ticketPrice * _numOfTickets, passed to Oil.burn
ownerTicketsPurchased local in enterDraw: cached userEntries[msg.sender] used for the 50-ticket cap
rand local in getRandom: keccak256 of block.timestamp, block.difficulty and block.coinbase
index local in getRandom: rand % players.length, the returned pseudo-random index
_drawId parameter of getWinnerByDraw used to index pastDraw
_player parameter of playerEntries whose entries are counted
addressOfPlayer local in playerEntries holding the searched address
arrayLength local in playerEntries holding players.length
totalEntries local in playerEntries incremented for each match in the loop
_address parameter of setOil assigned to oilAddress and cast to iOIL
_newTicketPrice parameter of setTicketPrice assigned to ticketPrice
_maxTickets parameter of setMaxTicket assigned to maxTicketsPerTx
_address parameter of transferOwnership assigned to owner
_firstSalt owner-supplied offset added to rand to select the first winner
_secondSalt owner-supplied offset added to firstWinner to select the second winner
_thirdSalt owner-supplied offset added to secondWinner to select the third winner
_fourthSalt owner-supplied offset added to thirdWinner to select the fourth winner
_fifthSalt owner-supplied offset added to fourthWinner to select the fifth winner
_sixthSalt owner-supplied offset added to fifthWinner to select the sixth winner
_seventhSalt owner-supplied offset added to sixthWinner to select the seventh winner
_eighthSalt owner-supplied offset added to seventhWinner to select the eighth winner
_ninethSalt owner-supplied offset added to eighthWinner to select the ninth winner
rand local in pickWinner holding the output of getRandom()

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged access control
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions
setOil is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
pickWinner is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
setTicketPrice is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
setMaxTicket is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
startEntries is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
stopEntries is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier
_numOfTickets is the user-controlled input of enterDraw
_numOfTickets multiplies ticketPrice in the ticket cost computation
ticketPrice feeds the ticketPrice * _numOfTickets multiplication
result of the multiplication is stored in totalTicketCost
ticketPrice is read to compute totalTicketCost
totalTicketCost is the amount argument of the external Oil.burn call
msg.sender is the from_ argument of Oil.burn
the stored iOIL interface is the target of the burn external call
enterDraw performs an external call to Oil.burn before mutating its own state
players.push state update executes after the external burn call, enabling reentrant state inconsistency
userEntries[msg.sender] is incremented after the external burn call, enabling reentrant entry duplication
enterDraw calls the external balanceOf view function for validation
msg.sender is the address queried by Oil.balanceOf
msg.sender indexes the userEntries mapping for reads and writes
ownerTicketsPurchased caches userEntries[msg.sender] before the cap check
msg.sender is pushed into the players array in the ticket loop
drawLive must be true for enterDraw to proceed
maxTicketsPerTx bounds _numOfTickets inside enterDraw
block.timestamp is used as a randomness source in getRandom, creating timestamp/weak-randomness dependency
pickWinner consumes getRandom, so the miner-influenced timestamp flows into winner selection
getRandom return value is stored in the pickWinner rand local
rand-derived indices determine which players are written into pastDraw
drawId is read and incremented nine times inside pickWinner
_firstSalt lets the owner shift the first winner, so winner selection is owner-influenceable
_secondSalt offset modifies the second winner index
_thirdSalt offset modifies the third winner index
_fourthSalt offset modifies the fourth winner index
_fifthSalt offset modifies the fifth winner index
_sixthSalt offset modifies the sixth winner index
_seventhSalt offset modifies the seventh winner index
_eighthSalt offset modifies the eighth winner index
_ninethSalt offset modifies the ninth winner index
_player is assigned to the addressOfPlayer local
players.length is copied into arrayLength
arrayLength bounds the comparison loop that increments totalEntries
players[i] is compared against the searched address while accumulating totalEntries
_drawId indexes pastDraw in getWinnerByDraw
pastDraw is read and returned by getWinnerByDraw
setOil assigns _address to oilAddress
setOil casts _address into the Oil interface used for later external calls
setTicketPrice writes _newTicketPrice into ticketPrice
setMaxTicket writes _maxTickets into maxTicketsPerTx
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to _address
startEntries sets drawLive to true
stopEntries sets drawLive to false
getPlayers returns the players array
drawEntrys returns players.length
